whatIs.title: What is 'What Should I Eat Today'?
whatIs.description: A random meal suggestion tool to solve the daily meal decision dilemma. Spin a roulette wheel, pick via tournament (repeatedly choose between two options), or let it auto-pick the top 3. Over 300 built-in options in 12 categories such as Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Western and snacks, with situation presets and favorites to narrow things down.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Select a mode — Roulette (random), Tournament (pick between two options repeatedly), or Top 3 (automatic top 3).
2. Narrow the options by situation (solo, group dinner, date...) or category (Korean/Chinese/Japanese/Western...).
4. If you don't like the result, spin again.

tips.title: Pro Tips
items: For team lunches or office dinners, use tournament mode to fairly aggregate everyone's preferences.
Tap 'Already ate today' on a menu to exclude it from results.
Add go-to menus to Favorites to see them right away next time.

items.a: Yes, favorites are saved in browser localStorage and persist on your next visit. Clearing browser data resets them.

items.q: The same menu keeps coming up — is it broken?
items.a: The roulette is completely random, so the same item can appear repeatedly. Exclude an item with 'Already ate today' or deselect its category.

items.q: Does it work well on mobile?
items.a: Yes, a responsive design optimized for mobile is applied. Spin the roulette or select options by touch.
